summary: E16 'Pinjam Armada / Sub-charter' feature testing completed successfully. All backend APIs (65/65 tests) and frontend UI elements working correctly. RBAC, Partner CRUD, Sub-charter lifecycle, AP calculations, COGS integration, and WhatsApp notifications (MOCKED) verified.
passed_tests: RBAC: Driver gets 403 on /api/partners and /api/subcharters (owner/ops_admin get 200)
Partner CRUD: List, Create, Read, Update with AP summary (ap_total, ap_paid, ap_outstanding, subcharter_count, vehicle_count)
Partner detail endpoint returns subcharters, settlements, and vehicles arrays
Sub-charter lifecycle: requested → confirmed (creates COGS expense) → settled (creates settlement) / cancelled (removes COGS)
AP calculations accurate: ap_total = Σ confirmed/settled costs, ap_paid = Σ settlements, ap_outstanding = total - paid
COGS expense created with category 'sewa_mitra' linked to booking_id and trip_id
Manual settlement reduces AP outstanding correctly
WhatsApp notifications (MOCKED): subcharter.requested and subcharter.confirmed events in automation_runs with send_wa actions
Anti-overlap validation: Cannot create overlapping sub-charter for same partner vehicle
Available partners endpoint returns partner vehicles free in time window
Partner deletion validation: Cannot delete partner with active sub-charter or vehicles
Frontend: Partners page loads with stats (AP Outstanding: Rp 2.200.000, Active Orders: 2, Partners: 5)
Frontend: Both tabs (Mitra & Utang, Order Sub-charter) functional
Frontend: Partner form dialog opens, fills, submits, and closes successfully
Frontend: Sub-charter form dialog opens and closes
Frontend: Partner detail drawer opens and closes
Frontend: Action buttons present (confirm, settle, cancel) based on sub-charter status
Light regression: dashboard, vehicles, drivers, customers, bookings, trips all return 200
